edit_team_profile.heading: Team profile
edit_team_profile.image_upload_modal_body: Add an extra element to your team's profile by adding a cover photo. Please ensure that the photo is at least 384 px wide with a height of 96 px. Images can be .jpg, .jpeg or .png and less than 2MB.
edit_team_profile.org_image_upload_modal_body: Add an extra element to your organization's profile by adding a cover photo. Please ensure that the photo is at least 384 px wide with a height of 96 px. Images can be .jpg, .jpeg or .png and less than 2MB.
edit_team_profile.profile_modal_body: Select the image you wish to upload. Images should not be more than 2MB in size. Only .jpg, .jpeg, .png files are accepted.
edit_team_profile.tagline_helper_text: Add a tagline to help users recognize you across Postman.
edit_team_profile.tagline_text_hint: Example: organize your customer data with our APIs!
edit_team_profile.helper_text: Your team name as you'd like it to be displayed on Postman.
edit_team_profile.org_helper_text: Your organization name as you'd like it to be displayed on Postman.
edit_team_profile.team_domain_helper_text: A unique team domain used to sign in and access your team dashboard.
edit_team_profile.org_domain_helper_text: A unique organization domain used to sign in and access your organization dashboard.
edit_team_profile.favicon_helper_text: Upload an ICO file to be used as a favicon for your team’s published documentation.
edit_team_profile.org_favicon_helper_text: Upload an ICO file to be used as a favicon for your organization’s published documentation.
edit_team_profile.favicon_upload_hint: Please upload an image of size 16x16 or 32x32.
edit_team_profile.image_size_not_supported: This image size is not supported. Try again.
edit_team_profile.make_profile_public_helper_text: This will allow others to discover your team on Postman and learn more about your team’s work.
edit_team_profile.make_org_profile_public_helper_text: This will allow others to discover your organization on Postman and learn more about your organization’s work.
edit_team_profile.customize_profile_para: Make your public profile amazing by adding an about section, links to your websites, highlighting your best APIs or collections, and more.
edit_team_profile.domain_name_error: Domain cannot contain uppercase letters. Only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens are allowed.
edit_team_profile.domain_length: The domain name must be 3 to 64 characters long.
edit_team_profile.handle_validity: Only alphanumeric characters and hyphens are allowed in the domain, it must begin and end with a letter.
